segments.text: Hello, support. — I signed the delivery note two days ago and the other side still does not see it. — Let me check the document status. It is signed on your side and waiting for the counterparty to accept it. — So it is stuck? — It is waiting, not stuck. They have to open it from their inbox. — And how would I know that? Nothing says so. — I agree it is not obvious.
